title: Genre Sampler
starter_code:
def shortest_sampler(songs: list[str], required: list[str]) -> int:
    pass

examples.explanation: The last three songs (rap, jazz, rock) include both required genres. No shorter stretch does.
No song is rap, so no stretch works.

constraints: every genre is 1 to 20 lowercase letters
required may contain repeats; each genre only needs to appear once

approaches.name: sliding window with genre counts and a 'genres covered' counter
try every start and extend until covered

steps.title: Clarify the input
steps.description: Asks what to return when no stretch works and when nothing is required, and whether repeats in the required list need multiple copies.
look_for: asks what to return if it's impossible
asks about an empty required list
asks whether duplicates in required matter
hints: Before you start, are there any inputs where the answer isn't obvious?
What should the answer be if a required genre never appears, or if nothing is required at all?
Settle the impossible case, the empty required list and repeated genres before you design the loop.

steps.title: Grow the window until it covers everything
steps.description: Extends a window to the right, tracking how many of each required genre it contains and how many required genres are fully covered.
look_for: keeps counts of genres in the window
tracks how many required genres are covered
hints: Think about how you know, at any moment, whether your current stretch is good enough.
Could you keep a running tally as you add songs, so you don't rescan the whole stretch?
Use a sliding window: counts per genre plus a counter of how many required genres are covered.

steps.title: Shrink from the left and record the best
steps.description: While the window still covers every required genre, records its length and moves the left edge forward to look for something shorter.
look_for: moves a left pointer while the window is valid
updates the best length inside that loop
hints: Look at what happens after your window first covers everything.
Once a stretch works, could a shorter one that ends at the same song also work?
Keep shrinking from the left, in a loop, as long as the window stays valid, and record the best length each time.

steps.title: Update coverage correctly when removing a song
steps.description: When a song leaves the window, decrements its count and only marks the genre uncovered when its count drops to zero.
look_for: decrements the count of the removed genre
only reduces coverage when a count hits zero
hints: Check what your code does when the song you remove has the same genre as another song still in the window.
If two rock songs are in the window and one leaves, is rock still covered?
A genre stops being covered only when its count in the window reaches zero.

steps.title: Handle the special cases
steps.description: Returns -1 when no stretch works and 0 when nothing is required, and treats repeated required genres as one.
look_for: returns 0 for an empty required list
hints: Try your code on an input where the answer doesn't exist.
What answer do you get if a required genre never shows up, or if nothing is required?
Return -1 when nothing works, 0 when nothing is required, and treat required as a set.

edge_cases.description: repeated genres in the required list
the answer is the whole playlist
the shortest stretch is at the very end

common_mistakes.description: shrinks the window only once per step instead of in a loop
common_mistakes.symptom: returns a stretch that is longer than necessary

common_mistakes.description: rescans the whole window each step to check coverage
common_mistakes.symptom: correct but O(n^2), too slow on long playlists

common_mistakes.description: treats repeated genres in required as needing multiple copies
common_mistakes.symptom: fails when required contains the same genre twice

common_mistakes.description: returns 0 instead of -1 when no stretch works

wrap_up_questions: What are the time and space complexity?
How would you return the actual stretch of songs, and what changes if the playlist streamed in forever?

origin_note: Original. Pattern: minimum covering window with counts.
